methods.attribution: Exact source institution identity links or a unique exact authority-name affiliation segment; no fuzzy matching. Unknown author shares remain unallocated.
methods.normalization: Within category/year/entity-type robust log 5–95% winsorization; normalized citation cohorts; bounded collaboration share; Shannon diversity; robust centered momentum. Minimum display cohort 2, not old certification threshold 30.
methods.overview: Equal mean of available normalized category scores, without filling absent categories.
methods.coverage: Most recent up to 250 source records per category/year. Different completeness across partitions; not census or probability sample.
